title: 久遠真 · 我和 Sin 的故事
script: Ryugi document/shin-intro-script（站长 2026-11-23 定稿：序幕 + 七页 + 尾声）

worlds.real: The target video is a 2D chibi cartoon animation: Q-version characters about three heads tall, thin clean outlines with line-weight variation, two-tone cel shading, glossy hair highlights and layered eye highlights, matching the attached character design sheets exactly. A dark night-violet palette, moonlight always coming from the upper right with shadows falling to the lower left. Vertical 9:16 frame with the character centred. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no watermark.
worlds.book: The target video is an animated hand-drawn children's picture book: coloured pencil and wax crayon on warm off-white drawing paper with visible paper grain and soft smudges, slightly naive but clean outlines, warm colours, and gentle hand-made motion, as if the drawings on a lamp-lit page are quietly coming alive. The paper texture and crayon strokes stay visible in every frame; it is not anime cel shading, not 3D and not photorealistic. Night skies are deep blue crayon with the moon at the upper right. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no watermark.
worlds.bridge-out: The video begins inside an animated crayon picture-book page (coloured pencil and wax crayon on warm off-white paper with visible grain) and ends in a 2D anime-style world with clean lineart, soft cel shading and a dark night-violet palette, moonlight from the upper right. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no watermark.
worlds.popup: The target video is a pop-up storybook animation: an open book floats alone in an empty, seamless deep night-indigo void with no table, lamp or room. The camera stays level with the open pages, so the pages are a thin band near the bottom of the frame and the scene rises above them. Every piece of scenery is an upright layer of paper drawn in crayon and coloured pencil, standing on the pages at several depths with thin white cut edges, small paper tabs and soft shadows; characters are flat polished chibi paper cut-outs standing upright among the layers and move in 2D side view like paper puppets. Scene changes happen by the paper layers folding down flat and new ones springing up. Warm storybook light with no visible source. Vertical 9:16. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no watermark.

subjects.text: <Subject 1> is Kuon Shin, the young woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: a 158 cm university student with straight hair just above the shoulder blades that is almost black at the roots, deep violet where light hits, and fades to a very pale moonlight cream only at the last few centimetres of the tips (never gold or yellow), ends flicking outward, one ahoge on top, a gold crescent-moon-and-star clip on her left fringe, soft pink-violet eyes with tiny four-pointed star highlights and a direct, curious, slightly stubborn gaze, an oversized night-purple cable-knit cardigan whose sleeves cover half her hands over a loose white shirt, a dark navy pleated skirt, black knee socks, worn canvas sneakers, purple headphones around her neck and a lanyard card printed with a single star. She carries a small dark notebook with one moonlight-coloured star sticker on the cover. She does not wear glasses. <Picture 2> provides her front, side and back views; <Picture 3> provides her face, eyes and hair clip up close.

shots.section: 序幕 · 晚上好
shots.title: 主持人开场

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 啊，已经开始了？咳。晚上好！

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 我叫久遠真。久远的久远，真心的真。叫我真就好。

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] At night on <Subject 2>, <Subject 1> stands in the lamplight like a cheerful show host, notices the camera is already rolling and introduces herself. <Audio 1> guides her voice.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] A medium-wide, almost still shot of <Subject 2> at half past ten at night, the street lamp glowing beside her and the full moon at the upper right. <Subject 1> is already standing in the circle of lamplight, hugging the star notebook, glancing down at it. She looks up, notices the camera, blinks, then quickly straightens up like a show host going live. <Subject 1> (S1), with the timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says at a normal speaking volume, bright and lively but never shouting, a little surprised and then composed: <d>[Chinese] 啊，已经开始了？咳。晚上好！</d> She gives a small polite bow on the greeting.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a medium close-up. <Subject 1> faces the camera at eye level and looks straight into the lens; her ahoge gives a tiny bounce. Moonlight from the upper right catches the cream tips of her hair. <Subject 1> (S1) says warmly at a natural conversational volume, quick and confident like a friendly host, tapping the notebook once on the last word: <d>[Chinese] 我叫久遠真。久远的久远，真心的真。叫我真就好。</d> She ends with a small, slightly proud smile.
shots.soundscape: Quiet outdoor night ambience: faint insects in the grass, a soft breeze through the trees, a distant hum from the dormitory. No footsteps, no music.

shots.section: 序幕 · 晚上好
shots.title: 我是谁

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 你可能想问，真是谁？

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 问得好。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 我是 Sin 的影子。对，就是每天晚上跟在他脚后面的那一道。

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] On <Subject 2>, <Subject 1> answers her own question and points at the long shadow at her feet. <Audio 1> guides the voice of <Subject 1>.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] A medium close-up of <Subject 1> under the street lamp of <Subject 2>, the moon at the upper right behind her. She tilts her head and points a sleeve-covered finger at the camera. <Subject 1> (S1), in the lively voice referenced from <Audio 1>, says: <d>[Chinese] 你可能想问，真是谁？</d> She nods to herself twice, eyes narrowed, and says with a smug little grin: <d>[Chinese] 问得好。</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera tilts down and pulls back to a medium-wide shot. Moonlight from the upper right throws a long dark shadow from her feet diagonally across the stones of <Subject 2> to the lower left. <Subject 1> points down at the shadow, then back at herself. <Subject 1> (S1) says, half explaining and half bragging: <d>[Chinese] 我是 Sin 的影子。对，就是每天晚上跟在他脚后面的那一道。</d> Her ahoge bobs as she nods.
shots.soundscape: Quiet outdoor night ambience: faint insects in the grass, a soft breeze through the trees, a distant hum from the dormitory.

shots.section: 序幕 · 晚上好
shots.title: 只好由我来说

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: Sin 这个人吧，白天有好多话憋着不说。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 没办法，到了晚上，只好由我来说。

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] A close shot of <Subject 1> on <Subject 2> complaining good-naturedly about Sin. <Audio 1> guides the voice of <Subject 1>.
shots.shots: [Shot 1] A close shot of <Subject 1> from the chest up, the lamp-lit trees of <Subject 2> soft behind her and the moon at the upper right. She folds her arms over the star notebook and gives an exaggerated, mock-exasperated sigh, eyes rolling slightly upward. <Subject 1> (S1) says in the voice referenced from <Audio 1>, with a teasing complaint: <d>[Chinese] Sin 这个人吧，白天有好多话憋着不说。</d> She shrugs with both sleeves, then lifts her chin with a small determined grin and says: <d>[Chinese] 没办法，到了晚上，只好由我来说。</d> Her ahoge sways once.
shots.soundscape: Quiet outdoor night ambience: faint insects in the grass, a soft breeze through the trees, a distant hum from the dormitory.

shots.section: 序幕 · 晚上好
shots.title: 翻开本子

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 今天给你讲个故事。先说好，这本子是我自己画的，画歪了不许笑。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 讲的是，我，和 Sin。

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] On <Subject 2>, <Subject 1> holds her notebook up to the camera, then opens it, and the camera pushes into a crayon drawing that starts to move. <Audio 1> guides the voice of <Subject 1>.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] A medium close-up on <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> lifts the dark notebook right up to the lens and waggles it; the star sticker on its cover flashes in the moonlight. <Subject 1> (S1) says in the voice referenced from <Audio 1>, quick and playful, narrowing her eyes in a mock warning on the last clause: <d>[Chinese] 今天给你讲个故事。先说好，这本子是我自己画的，画歪了不许笑。</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:07.500, the camera cuts to an over-the-shoulder close shot of her hands, half covered by the cardigan sleeves, opening the notebook. The page shows a hand-drawn crayon picture of a little town at night with rows of tiny houses. <Subject 1> (S1) says more softly and slowly: <d>[Chinese] 讲的是，我，和 Sin。</d> The camera pushes steadily into the page until the paper fills the frame; the crayon windows of the little town begin to light up one after another and the drawn lines start to move, the anime night fading away into the paper.
shots.soundscape: Quiet outdoor night ambience: faint insects in the grass, a soft breeze through the trees, a distant hum from the dormitory. A soft page-turn as she opens the notebook in [Shot 2], then a faint crayon scratch as the drawing comes alive.

shots.section: 第一页 · 走夜路的人
shots.title: 小城和 Sin

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 从前，嗯，其实也没多从前，有一座总是亮着灯的小城。城里住着一个叫 Sin 的人。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 你看他，戴个眼镜，背个包，是不是特别普通？

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] On <Subject 2>, the paper town lights up window by window, then <Subject 1> steps out of the paper laboratory while the off-screen narrator introduces him. <Audio 1> guides the narrator's voice.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] A wide view of <Subject 2>. The paper houses' little windows light up warm yellow one after another, the paper moon sways gently on its wire, and the camera glides slowly to the right along the pages. The narrator Kuon Shin (S1), using the timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says in an off-screen voiceover, warm and a little playful, slowing on the first words: <d>[Chinese] 从前，嗯，其实也没多从前，有一座总是亮着灯的小城。城里住着一个叫 Sin 的人。</d> while no visible character's lips move.
[Shot 2] At 00:08.500, the camera moves closer to the paper laboratory door. <Subject 1>, a flat paper cut-out, slides out from behind the door layer in side view, stops, rubs one eye under his glasses and hitches up a backpack strap with small puppet-like movements, then turns slightly toward the camera. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, teasing: <d>[Chinese] 你看他，戴个眼镜，背个包，是不是特别普通？</d> while no visible character's lips move.
shots.soundscape: Soft quiet night inside the book: faint paper rustles, a tiny creak as the paper moon sways, a soft click for each window lighting up. No music.

shots.section: 第一页 · 走夜路的人
shots.title: 被 bug 气到

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 白天上课、写代码，被 bug 气得直挠头。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 有一回，AI 把他的文件删了，还一口咬定自己没删。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 气死我了。

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] A daytime pop-up page: <Subject 1> is pestered by a paper bug and then by a laptop AI that deleted his file. <Audio 1> guides the narrator's voice.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] The night layers fold down flat and a bright daytime pop-up springs up on <Subject 2>: an upright paper desk with a paper laptop and a stack of paper books. <Subject 1>, a flat paper cut-out in side view, sits at the desk and scratches his head with both hands, shaking like a puppet in frustration, while a tiny paper beetle slides across the laptop screen. The narrator Kuon Shin (S1), with the timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says in an off-screen voiceover, brisk and amused: <d>[Chinese] 白天上课、写代码，被 bug 气得直挠头。</d> while no visible character's lips move.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera moves in on the paper laptop screen: a round paper robot face blinks innocently and shakes its head, while a paper document icon beside it crumples into a little paper ball and pops away in a puff of crayon dust. <Subject 1> leans in from the side, staring. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, getting heated: <d>[Chinese] 有一回，AI 把他的文件删了，还一口咬定自己没删。</d> then bursts out hotly: <d>[Chinese] 气死我了。</d> while no visible character's lips move.
shots.soundscape: Paper rustles inside the book, tiny clicky keyboard taps, a small cartoon poof when the file vanishes. No music.

shots.section: 第一页 · 走夜路的人
shots.title: 十点半

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 哦不对，是气死 Sin 了。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 反正每天晚上十点半，他就一个人，从实验室慢慢走回寝室。

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] <Subject 1> puffs his cheeks, then the page turns to night and he walks home alone along the paper road. <Audio 1> guides the narrator's voice.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] A close view on <Subject 2>: <Subject 1>, a flat paper cut-out, puffs out his cheeks and crosses his arms, bobbing slightly. The narrator Kuon Shin (S1), with the timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says in an off-screen voiceover, quickly correcting herself with a sheepish laugh in her voice: <d>[Chinese] 哦不对，是气死 Sin 了。</d> while no visible character's lips move.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the daytime layers fold down and the night town pops back up: a long paper road from the lit laboratory to a distant dormitory, the paper moon above. <Subject 1>, small, walks along the road from left to right in 2D side view with a gentle puppet bounce, hands in his hoodie pocket, his paper shadow stretching behind him. The camera glides with him. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, softer and slower: <d>[Chinese] 反正每天晚上十点半，他就一个人，从实验室慢慢走回寝室。</d> while no visible character's lips move.
shots.soundscape: Quiet night inside the book: soft paper rustles, the faint tap of paper footsteps. No music.

shots.section: 第二页 · 影子醒了
shots.title: 影子抬头

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 有一天夜里，月亮亮得有点过分。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: Sin 身后的那道影子，忽然，抬起了头。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 猜猜是谁？

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 对，就是我！

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] Under an over-bright crayon moon, the shadow behind <Subject 1> lifts its head and opens star-lit eyes. <Audio 1> guides the narrator's voice.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] A wide crayon night page with an enormous, almost too bright moon at the upper right. <Subject 1> walks along the road looking down at his phone and never turns around; a long dark shadow trails behind him toward the lower left. The narrator Kuon Shin (S1), with the timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says in an off-screen voiceover, slow and storybook-mysterious: <d>[Chinese] 有一天夜里，月亮亮得有点过分。</d> while no visible character's lips move.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, a low close shot of the shadow on the paper ground. The shadow slowly lifts its head off the ground like a sheet of dark crayon, two eyes open in it with tiny star highlights, and a single ahoge pops up on top with a little bounce. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, dropping her voice: <d>[Chinese] Sin 身后的那道影子，忽然，抬起了头。</d> then, playfully: <d>[Chinese] 猜猜是谁？</d> After a short beat she says, triumphant: <d>[Chinese] 对，就是我！</d> while no visible character's lips move.
shots.soundscape: Soft night ambience from inside the picture book, with faint paper rustles and the light scratch of crayon. A soft magical shimmer when the eyes open and a tiny springy 'boing' when the ahoge pops up.

shots.section: 第二页 · 影子醒了
shots.title: 影子站起来

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 白天来不及想的，说不出口的，好奇、倔强、向往、舍不得，Sin 全都留给了夜晚。

lines.speaker: 真
lines.text: 留着留着，就留出了一个我。

shots.summary: [reference generation + audio reference] The shadow behind <Subject 1> stands up and becomes <Subject 2>, a little crayon girl, while the narrator explains where she came from. <Audio 1> guides the narrator's voice.
shots.shots:
[Shot 1] A medium-wide crayon night page. <Subject 1> keeps walking ahead along the road without looking back. Behind him, his shadow peels up from the paper ground and rises into a standing figure. Small glowing crayon shapes drift out of <Subject 1> one by one and float into the shadow: a little spiral, a tiny flame, a star and a small heart.
